device_entry.description: 用于通过串口管理一组 Zaber 串联设备的非实体控制组件，可统一暴露位移台、滤轮和 LED 控制器等子设备，供显微与实验自动化系统调用。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical control component for managing a set of daisy-chained Zaber devices over a serial connection. It exposes child devices such as stages, filter wheels, and LED controllers for microscopy and laboratory automation workflows.

schema.description: 枚举并返回该串联系统中已配置的 Zaber 子设备。
schema.description_en: Enumerate and return the configured Zaber child devices in this daisy-chained system.
